'''Lapis Sheqoa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was a former [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. He served as the [[Head of Security/Legends|Head of Security]] for the [[Marblewood security force|security forces]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun sector chief|Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]] as well as serving as his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. During the [[Marblewood Estate heist]], Sheqoa was crushed by Viliachor's safe and killed.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
